spans.text: If you cannot confidently verify a claim, leave it unchanged unless clearly false. Do not guess.
spans.note: The prompt strongly emphasizes truthfulness and accuracy. It requires all changes to be grounded in verifiable evidence from the codebase, prohibits speculative or undocumented features, and instructs the AI to leave claims unchanged if they cannot be confidently verified rather than guessing.

spans.text: Do not create, delete, or edit any other files. YOU ARE NOT ALLOWED TO CHANGE ANY FILE OTHER THAN `README.md`.
spans.note: The prompt demonstrates strong tool and action safety principles. It strictly limits the scope of file modifications to only README.md, explicitly prohibits creating, deleting, or editing any other files, requires non-destructive evidence gathering, and mandates reverting any unintended changes to other files.
